intro: During the autumn celebration of Hallow's End, adventurers visiting Stormwind City can help a local orphan collect festive sweets. To earn a piece of Stormwind Nougat from Innkeeper Allison at the Gilded Rose, visitors are playfully made to strike a mighty flexing pose before she hands over the treat.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: That's an... Interesting costume you have on. Even though you're being nice and helping a sick child trick-or-treat this year, I'm afraid I'm going to have to ask you perform a trick for me!
Let's see... You look so strong and buff in that... Costume... Let's see you flex! Yes, go on now and flex for me, strong friend!
When and only when you flex, I'll give you some tasty Stormwind Nougat. It's a great Hallow's End treat.

clips.title: Progress
paras: No candy until you flex for me, friend...

clips.title: Completion
paras: You are truly mighty, haha! Well done, and thanks for being such a good sport. Here's your candy.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
